beats.title: The toiling spirit
beats.cap: Chained to a stone in the fields, a spirit of Runeheim toiled without rest.

beats.title: You come closer
beats.cap: With its Binder gone, you came closer.

beats.title: Its struggle
beats.cap: You saw how the chains had worn it thin.

beats.title: The rune on the stone
beats.cap: The old rune flickered, as if it knew you.

beats.title: Your hand on the stone
beats.cap: You laid your hand on the stone — and your eyes burned rune-blue.

beats.title: The chains break
beats.cap: The chains burst apart.

beats.title: Free
beats.cap: For the first time in years, a soul of Runeheim was free.

beats.title: Lines beneath your feet
beats.cap: Beneath your feet, lines of light ran out into the land.

beats.title: Life follows the light
beats.cap: And where the light ran, the land remembered green.

beats.title: Her thanks
beats.cap: "Thank you. Now I can go home."

beats.title: Toward the village
beats.cap: She drifted away over the hills, toward the village.

beats.title: Home on the Green
beats.cap: On the Green she waited, glowing — the first to come home.

beats.title: The cage
beats.cap: At the top of the tower, Surtharn's wardens had caged a builder.

beats.title: Free
beats.cap: "Free at last! I'll raise the bridge to Fernheim."

beats.title: The river wall
beats.cap: The Silverrun ran like a wall between the realms.

beats.title: The plan
beats.cap: Bram drew the bridge on parchment, then in the air with his hammer.

beats.title: Timber and stone
beats.cap: Timber from Gildenmark, stone from the riverbank.

beats.title: Runes in the stone
beats.cap: Every stone he set, he marked with a rune.

beats.title: Under the northern lights
beats.cap: They worked through the night under the northern lights.

beats.title: The keystone
beats.cap: At dawn, the keystone.

beats.title: The bridge
beats.cap: Bram built the Silverrun bridge.

beats.title: The first to cross
beats.cap: For the first time in years, Gildenmark and Fernheim touch again.

scenes.name: Mira's lift up the Great Scar

beats.title: The cage
beats.cap: In a tower above the marsh, the wardens had caged a mechanic.

beats.title: Free
beats.cap: "Thank you! My lift will carry you up to Cragland."

beats.title: The Great Scar
beats.cap: The Great Scar: a mountain torn in two.

beats.title: Measuring
beats.cap: Mira measured the cliff twice, and the wind three times.

beats.title: Gears and a rune-heart
beats.cap: Gears, chains — and a rune-stone heart.

beats.title: The first chain
beats.cap: Someone had to carry the first chain to the top.

beats.title: Lanterns on the cliff
beats.cap: By night the cliff glittered with her lanterns.

beats.title: The lever
beats.cap: Then she pulled the lever.

beats.title: Up the Scar
beats.cap: Mira's lift climbs the Great Scar.

beats.title: Cragland
beats.cap: The road to Cragland is open.

scenes.name: Dunn's iron bridge over the Cinder Chasm

beats.title: The cage
beats.cap: High in the mountains, the wardens had caged a dwarf forger.

beats.title: Free
beats.cap: "Ha! Let me at my anvil — an iron bridge to Cinderheim it is!"

beats.title: The chasm
beats.cap: The Cinder Chasm opened the night the sky went quiet.

beats.title: A forge on the edge
beats.cap: Dunn built a forge on the edge of the chasm.

beats.title: Runes in the iron
beats.cap: Iron for the heat, runes for the holding.

beats.title: Out over the fire
beats.cap: Beam by beam, out over the fire.

beats.title: Between lava and aurora
beats.cap: Lava below, the northern lights above.

beats.title: The last rivet
beats.cap: Dunn drives the last rivet.

beats.title: Across
beats.cap: Across the Cinder Chasm lie Cinderheim.

beats.title: The smoke of Muspelheim
beats.cap: And beyond them, the smoke of Muspelheim.

scenes.name: Vela's passes over the Ember Wall

beats.title: The cage
beats.cap: In a tower in the ash, the wardens had caged a sky captain.

beats.title: Free
beats.cap: "You found me! The sky ports are yours to command."

beats.title: The Ember Wall
beats.cap: The Ember Wall had burned for twenty-eight years.

beats.title: The old ways
beats.cap: Vela knew the old ways over the ridge.

beats.title: The sky skiff
beats.cap: And she knew the winds.

beats.title: Over the fire
beats.cap: They sailed over the fire under the northern lights.

beats.title: Rune-lanterns
beats.cap: Where her rune-lanterns fell, the fire cooled to stone.

beats.title: The pass
beats.cap: A pass through the Ember Wall.

beats.title: The sky port
beats.cap: The sky ports are yours to command — all Runeheim is open.

scenes.name: The opening — the Long Quiet, the storm and the twins

beats.title: The cycle of souls
beats.cap: Once, the dead rose along the World Tree — and new souls came down it into every cradle.

beats.title: The road goes quiet
beats.cap: Then the road went quiet.

beats.title: Empty cradles
beats.cap: In the last village, the cradles stood empty — twelve winters, and not one child.

beats.title: The edge of the light
beats.cap: The dead drifted at the edge of the light — and the Binders came for them.

beats.title: The storm
beats.cap: Then came the worst storm anyone remembered — and the lightning struck the runestones.

beats.title: The basket
beats.cap: At dawn, a basket drifted out of Mirror Lake.

beats.title: Two babes
beats.cap: Inside lay two babes, their eyes glowing rune-blue.

beats.title: Raised by the village
beats.cap: The village raised them on goat's milk and old songs.

beats.title: The stones wake
beats.cap: They read runes no one else could — and the old stones woke for them.

beats.title: Sixteen winters on
beats.cap: Sixteen winters on, the twins were nearly grown.

beats.title: The choice
beats.cap: One would go out into Runeheim; the other would stay and keep the village.

beats.title: The send-off
beats.cap: And so one twin went out — and the other stayed.

beats.title: The roads to every realm
beats.cap: Once, the roads of Gildenmark ran to every realm.

beats.title: The walls rise
beats.cap: One by one, the other realms fell — and the walls rose.

beats.title: The last village
beats.cap: Only Gildenmark was left.

beats.title: No child
beats.cap: And no child was born.

beats.title: The dead at the edge
beats.cap: The dead drifted at the edge of the light…

beats.title: Over the walls
beats.cap: …until the Binders came over the walls for them.

beats.title: The humming stones
beats.cap: And bindstones began to hum in the fields.

beats.title: Orchards and honey
beats.cap: Once Cinderheim was orchards and honey.

beats.title: The sky turns red
beats.cap: The night the gate shut, the sky turned red.

beats.title: Fire and ash
beats.cap: Fire and ash fell on Cinderheim.

beats.title: The Ember Wall
beats.cap: The Ember Wall rose in one night.

beats.title: The Cinder Chasm
beats.cap: And the Cinder Chasm split the earth.

beats.title: Grey morning
beats.cap: By morning, Cinderheim was grey.

beats.title: Bound to dig
beats.cap: Their souls were bound — and made to dig.

beats.title: The mines
beats.cap: Cragland lived by the mines.

beats.title: A voice in the stone
beats.cap: Then the stone began to sing.

beats.title: Deeper
beats.cap: "Deeper," said the voice.

beats.title: The mountain breaks
beats.cap: So the mountain dug toward them.

beats.title: The Great Scar
beats.cap: And the Great Scar tore open.

beats.title: Silence
beats.cap: Three years after the Ash Night, Cragland fell.

beats.title: They dig still
beats.cap: The miners dig still — for him.

beats.title: Mills and boats
beats.cap: Fernheim was mills and boats on the Silverrun.

beats.title: The river turns black
beats.cap: Then the Silverrun ran black from the south.

beats.title: Backwards
beats.cap: The mill wheels turned backwards.

beats.title: The marsh rises
beats.cap: The marshes drank the villages.

beats.title: A wall of water
beats.cap: And the river became a wall.

beats.title: It came up through
beats.cap: "It came up through."

beats.title: Mist
beats.cap: Three years after the Stone-Fall, Fernheim was gone.

beats.title: The sky parts
beats.cap: Twenty spirits free — and the sky showed you something.

beats.title: The gate
beats.cap: High above, a golden gate had shut.

beats.title: The mask
beats.cap: On Odin's high seat sat someone in a golden mask.

beats.title: No soul rises
beats.cap: No soul could rise…

beats.title: None come down
beats.cap: …and none came down.

beats.title: The sky closes
beats.cap: Then the sky closed again.

scenes.name: A glimpse: two lights in the dark

beats.title: Once more
beats.cap: Thirty spirits free — and the sky opened once more.

beats.title: A dark hall
beats.cap: In a dark hall far above…

beats.title: Two lights
beats.cap: …two great lights floated side by side…

beats.title: Asleep
beats.cap: …asleep.

beats.title: The watcher
beats.cap: And something in a golden mask kept watch.

beats.title: Both look up
beats.cap: Far apart, both twins looked up at the same moment.

beats.title: The last ember
beats.cap: Surtharn's last ember went out.

beats.title: The great hearth
beats.cap: Behind his throne lay the great hearth.

beats.title: The staff on the anvil
beats.cap: You laid the staff on the anvil…

beats.title: Four Heartglasses
beats.cap: …and set the four Heartglasses round it.

beats.title: They rise
beats.cap: The glasses rose.

beats.title: Their light
beats.cap: And poured their light into the staff.

beats.title: The star wakes
beats.cap: A white star woke at its crown.

beats.title: The Lodestar
beats.cap: The Lodestar.

beats.title: Muspelheim shakes
beats.cap: And Muspelheim began to fall.

beats.title: Run
beats.cap: You ran.

beats.title: Every chain
beats.cap: Every chain you passed, broke.

beats.title: The causeway
beats.cap: Out onto the causeway.

beats.title: Sinking behind you
beats.cap: It sank behind you, stone by stone.

beats.title: The shore
beats.cap: From the shore, you watched.

beats.title: Into the sea
beats.cap: Muspelheim fell into the sea.

beats.title: The sky clears
beats.cap: And the sky cleared.

beats.title: The sky opens
beats.cap: With the fire broken, the sky began to open.

beats.title: A city in the sky
beats.cap: Asgard.

beats.title: Coming down
beats.cap: It came down slowly, as if it were tired.

beats.title: On the lake
beats.cap: And came to rest on Mirror Lake.

beats.title: The gate and the pier
beats.cap: Its gate faced the village pier.

beats.title: The notch
beats.cap: The staff fit the notch — but it did not wake.

beats.title: Home
beats.cap: You ran home with the Lodestar.

beats.title: At the books
beats.cap: Your twin was where they always were — at the books.

beats.title: The oldest saga
beats.cap: "The oldest saga — the one nobody could read."

beats.title: One rune
beats.cap: On its last page, a single rune.

beats.title: Together
beats.cap: You read it together.

beats.title: GODSBANE
beats.cap: GODSBANE.

beats.title: "I'll be there"
beats.cap: "When you reach the gods, I'll be there."

beats.title: The notch waits
beats.cap: At the end of the pier, the notch waited.

beats.title: The word
beats.cap: You spoke the word, and set the staff.

beats.title: Along the lines
beats.cap: On the Green, the spirits gathered along the lines.

beats.title: The star blazes
beats.cap: The star blazed.

beats.title: A bridge of light
beats.cap: And a bridge of light ran out across the lake.

beats.title: Blessed
beats.cap: The spirits blessed the road.

beats.title: To Asgard
beats.cap: The Bifröst — to Asgard's gate.

beats.title: The deep halls
beats.cap: In the deepest hall of Muspelheim, the spirits dug.

beats.title: The throne cracks
beats.cap: The throne of Muspelheim split open.

beats.title: Lava rises
beats.cap: Fire rose from below.

beats.title: A hand of fire
beats.cap: A hand of fire took hold.

beats.title: The Molten Colossus
beats.cap: Surtharn, the Molten Colossus!

beats.title: Facing him
beats.cap: "Every gem of Runeheim is mine by right!"

beats.title: Staggered
beats.cap: He staggered…

beats.title: The sword in the floor
beats.cap: …and drove his sword into the floor.

beats.title: Melting
beats.cap: The sword melted.

beats.title: Armour
beats.cap: The iron climbed him.

beats.title: Hammer and crown
beats.cap: The Forge-king!

beats.title: The shockwave
beats.cap: His hammer rang the cavern.

beats.title: Cracks
beats.cap: The Forge-king cracked…

beats.title: A storm of ash
beats.cap: …and burst into ash.

beats.title: The spirits pulled in
beats.cap: The ash took the spirits with it.

beats.title: The Ash Tyrant
beats.cap: The Ash Tyrant!

beats.title: A shield of souls
beats.cap: He hid behind the souls he had chained.

beats.title: Through the ash
beats.cap: You pushed on through the ash.

beats.title: Rising ash
beats.cap: The ash rose…

beats.title: Huge
beats.cap: …and he grew.

beats.title: Horns
beats.cap: Horns tore from his brow.

beats.title: Into the fire
beats.cap: He reached into the fire…

beats.title: The Sword of Flame
beats.cap: …and drew the Sword of Flame!

beats.title: Tiny
beats.cap: The Horned Jötunn.

beats.title: The fall
beats.cap: He fell into the fire.

beats.title: Boiling
beats.cap: The lava boiled.

beats.title: A black hand
beats.cap: Something black rose from it.

beats.title: Obsidian
beats.cap: He climbed out in black glass.

beats.title: The molten heart
beats.cap: His molten heart burned behind the glass.

beats.title: The Obsidian Warlord
beats.cap: The Obsidian Warlord!

beats.title: Shattered
beats.cap: The obsidian shattered.

beats.title: Swelling
beats.cap: He swelled…

beats.title: Lava from his crown
beats.cap: …lava poured from his crown…

beats.title: The cavern erupts
beats.cap: …and the cavern erupted.

beats.title: The volcano itself
beats.cap: The last ember — Surtharn becomes the volcano itself!

beats.title: Amid the fire
beats.cap: Now — or never.

beats.title: The throne hall
beats.cap: The throne hall of Asgard.

beats.title: The high seat
beats.cap: On Odin's high seat, the masked one waited.

beats.title: He rises
beats.cap: He rose.

beats.title: Wings of light
beats.cap: Wings of light unfolded.

beats.title: Gungnir
beats.cap: A god of gold — Solmyrk, the Black Sun.

beats.title: Before him
beats.cap: You raised the Lodestar.

beats.title: The blow
beats.cap: The light struck the mask…

beats.title: A crack
beats.cap: …and it cracked.

beats.title: Black light
beats.cap: Black light poured out.

beats.title: Torn wings
beats.cap: His wings tore into darkness.

beats.title: Half and half
beats.cap: Behind the Allfather's face, something else is looking out.

beats.title: Bracing
beats.cap: You held your ground.

scenes.name: The Storm That Ends the World

beats.title: The mask shatters
beats.cap: The mask shattered.

beats.title: The light drains
beats.cap: All the light of Asgard drained into him…

beats.title: Storm
beats.cap: …and he swelled into storm.

beats.title: Eclipse
beats.cap: The sun went dark behind him.

beats.title: The Storm That Ends the World
beats.cap: The Storm That Ends the World!

beats.title: The Lodestar raised
beats.cap: And what was left was the dark that had always been underneath.

beats.title: The Lodestar's light
beats.cap: The Lodestar's light struck the storm.

beats.title: The storm tears
beats.cap: The storm tore open…

beats.title: The dark comes apart
beats.cap: …and the dark came apart.

beats.title: The light comes home
beats.cap: The light he stole flowed home.

beats.title: The mask falls
beats.cap: His mask fell.

beats.title: The mask in pieces
beats.cap: Solmyrk fell, and his mask lay in pieces.

beats.title: The citadel shakes
beats.cap: The citadel shook.

beats.title: Golden doors
beats.cap: Behind the high seat, golden doors swung open.

beats.title: The feast hall
beats.cap: The feast hall of the gods.

beats.title: The orbs
beats.cap: Two great orbs, joined like an infinity sign — and voices inside.

beats.title: Your twin comes
beats.cap: And your twin came running to your side.

beats.title: Together
beats.cap: Together, you spoke the word.

beats.title: Into the centre
beats.cap: Godsbane — into the centre, where the two lights meet.

beats.title: Cracks
beats.cap: The orbs cracked…

beats.title: A million shards
beats.cap: …and burst into a million shards of light.

beats.title: Free
beats.cap: Odin and Freya — free.

beats.title: The hall wakes
beats.cap: And the feast hall woke.

beats.title: You came
beats.cap: "You came. Twenty-eight winters we slept in our own light — and still you came."

beats.title: Why the stones light
beats.cap: "Do you know why the runestones light for you?"

beats.title: One breath of light
beats.cap: "The night the false one took us, we had one breath of light left…"

beats.title: Down in the storm
beats.cap: "We sent you down in the storm."

beats.title: The basket of light
beats.cap: "The lightning woke the runestones, so that one day they would wake for you."

beats.title: The last gift
beats.cap: "You are our last gift to Runeheim."

beats.title: Bring the Lodestar
beats.cap: "Come. The spirits have waited long enough."

beats.title: The rune circle
beats.cap: At the heart of Asgard, the rune circle.

beats.title: The Lodestar set
beats.cap: The Lodestar, set at the heart.

beats.title: Into the sky
beats.cap: Godsbane — into the sky.

beats.title: The Bifröst rises
beats.cap: The Bifröst rose into heaven.

beats.title: From every realm
beats.cap: From every realm, the spirits came.

beats.title: They lead them home
beats.cap: Odin and Freya led them home.

beats.title: Valhalla and Fólkvangr
beats.cap: Valhalla for the brave, Fólkvangr for the rest.

beats.title: Into legend
beats.cap: The familiars and the fairy monarchs went with them — into legend.

beats.title: Farewell
beats.cap: "Go to your village. We will follow."

beats.title: The sky closes
beats.cap: And the sky closed softly behind them.

beats.title: Home
beats.cap: You came home.

beats.title: Look up
beats.cap: "Runeheim! Look up."

beats.title: Every stone at once
beats.cap: Every runestone woke at once.

beats.title: The spring
beats.cap: "And now… the spring."

beats.title: The vines run
beats.cap: The spring ran out along the soul-lines.

beats.title: Roads of grass
beats.cap: The lines of light became roads.

beats.title: The monsters fade
beats.cap: The monsters faded into light.

beats.title: The forges sink
beats.cap: The forges sank into the sea.

beats.title: Asgard settles
beats.cap: Asgard settled into the lake.

beats.title: Out on the new roads
beats.cap: People walked out on the new roads.

beats.title: Hamlets
beats.cap: And homes rose in every realm.

beats.title: A green Runeheim
beats.cap: Runeheim was green again.

beats.title: The feast
beats.cap: The village celebrated the twins.

beats.title: Dancing
beats.cap: They danced till the stars came out.

beats.title: Seasons
beats.cap: Time passed.

beats.title: The first cry
beats.cap: And a child was born.

beats.title: Pip and Wren
beats.cap: Pip and Wren, among the first.

beats.title: Playing twins
beats.cap: "We play twins. I always have to be {O}…"

beats.title: Cradles
beats.cap: Every hamlet had its own.

beats.title: From the hill
beats.cap: And children were born again in Runeheim.

beats.title: The night lake
beats.cap: (the credits)

beats.title: Forty stars
beats.cap: Forty spirits, home.

beats.title: The hill
beats.cap: Runeheim is green again.

beats.title: The road on
beats.cap: Your journey goes on.

scenes.name: The World Tree under the lake

beats.title: The fortieth
beats.cap: The fortieth spirit, free.

beats.title: The last line
beats.cap: Its line ran to meet the others.

beats.title: One tree
beats.cap: Forty lines — one tree.

beats.title: Into the lake
beats.cap: Its light flowed into the lake…

beats.title: Under the water
beats.cap: …and shone under the water like a tattoo.

beats.title: On the pier
beats.cap: Where the twins were found, the World Tree shines.

beats.title: Boats over light
beats.cap: And it stayed.

beats.title: Whole
beats.cap: Whole at last.
